items: Unit testing: tests individual parts such as functions or classes in isolation; Python's unittest module is often used.
Integration testing: checks how parts of the code work together.
Functional testing: checks that the software behaves as expected from the user's point of view.
Regression testing: makes sure new changes do not break existing features.
